Name: Azure Key Vault
Description: Get secrets from Azure Key Vault and store them in output variables

Properties.Name: Azure account details
Properties.Description: Provide details to authenticate with Azure Key Vault

Properties.Name: Custom Azure module version
Properties.Description: Optionally: specify custom version of module Az.KeyVault to be used. If not specified the system default will be imported.

Properties.Name: Custom Azure module location
Properties.Description: Optionally: specify custom path on the file system where Az.KeyVault module is located. If not specified the default locations will be searched.

Properties.Name: Secrets to get
Properties.Description: New-line-separated list of secrets. Optionally provide secret version and output variable name. If output variable name is not specified - it will be constructed as {VaultName.SecretName}. If secret version is not specified - latest version will be fetched. Line syntax: secretName [secretVersion] [| outputVariableName]
